Mini lesson

How calendars keep time

The Gregorian calendar repeats a seven-day week while month lengths and leap years shift the weekday.

Seven-day cycle

Every date moves one weekday forward from the previous date.

Month lengths

Months have 30 or 31 days, except February with 28 or 29.

Leap-year rule

Divisible by 4, except century years unless also divisible by 400.

How does the app calculate a weekday?

It creates the selected date in Coordinated Universal Time and reads its position in the seven-day cycle. UTC prevents local timezone changes from moving the date backward or forward.
